lines.x: The DSEX gained as insurance and bank stocks rallied, with all seven tracked private banks posting gains.
Bangladesh successfully connected the initial unit of the Russian-built Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant to the national electricity grid for trial operations.
Protests over wages affected 317 factories in Bangladesh, incurring $428 million in sector losses and shifting $254 million in apparel orders to competing foreign countries.
Bangladesh deployed extra paramilitary forces following arson attacks on political leaders' homes, police stations, and local financial institutions across the country.
